product.name: Empathy website canary — ようこそ
product.description: A disposable consumer of independent repository website profiles.

documentation.title: Empathy consumer documentation
documentation.introduction: This disposable site tests optional website composition without changing the repository publication.

pages.title: Choose a website profile
pages.summary: The universal repository baseline does not require a website.
pages.body: Select the generic React/Vite profile for an application shell or the LaunchKit profile for developer-product content. Both compose Zensical documentation, architecture and legal surfaces through pinned Holon inputs.

pages.title: Localization readiness
pages.body: The current renderer declares English. Unicode source such as café, ようこそ and مرحبا must survive generation. Translated routing and locale selection require a supported owner interface; this canary does not claim those features.

architecture.title: Website composition boundaries
architecture.introduction: Empathy supplies reviewed repository intent; specialist implementations remain with their owners.
architecture.diagram:
flowchart LR
  Empathy[Consumer intent] --> Holon[Holon profiles]
  Identity[Identity tokens] --> Holon
  Holon --> Artifact[Disposable site artifact]
  Artifact --> Review[Human review]

decisions.title: Preserve specialist ownership
decisions.summary: The existing repository decision is accepted for review, rather than a newly ratified decision. Website generation remains in Holon; token generation remains in Identity.

legal.title: Attribution and source boundaries
legal.introduction: This fixture reuses public repository sources and does not create a new legal policy.

pages.title: Made with Love
pages.summary: Made with love by Ego Hygiene.
pages.body: Empathy supplies integration intent. Holon supplies the generic and LaunchKit website profiles; Zensical supplies documentation rendering; Identity supplies generated brand tokens and assets. See the pinned owners and their preserved upstream notices before redistribution.

pages.title: Source licensing
pages.summary: Use the canonical repository license and retained third-party notices.
pages.body: The Empathy repository LICENSE is the canonical source for its content. Generated consumers preserve Holon and Zensical third-party notices. This fixture does not infer rights approval for other imported files.
